facts.release861: Apply Configuration / Remove Mapping per content reference

title: On 8.61 the configurator's save maps nothing; Apply Configuration maps chosen content references (8.62's save maps them all)
statement: On 8.61.15, EOCC_CONFIGURE SavePreChange writes the configuration rows only; the Map to Portal Registry tab's Apply Configuration (EOCC_CONFIG_WRK.EOCC_MAP_PB) and Remove Mapping (EOCC_REMOVE_PB) map or unmap the selected content references, committing at once. On 8.62.09 SavePreChange calls AddEventMapping / RemoveEventMapping for every content reference. The EventMapping Mapper class is identical on both releases, so the mapped rows are the same.

observations.observation: A Standard configuration saved in PIA wrote header, sequence, field and role rows and moved no counter; Apply Configuration then wrote PSPTCS_SRVCFG and four PSPTCSSRVCONF rows (RCSCM +1, SCNFM +4, SYS +5); Remove Mapping wrote four PSPTCSSRVCNFDEL and one PSPTCSSRVCFGDEL with the same steps.
